source: Empirical black-box gameplay measurements on SC2 4.10.0.75689 via s2clientprotocol (kinematics, combat timing, splash bounds, Zealot charge, building range radii, and follow-lock delays).

units_of_measure.heading_blend: fraction of remaining heading error closed per loop
units_of_measure.attack_windup: loops from facing alignment to firing
units_of_measure.attack_arc: rad, maximum residual angle to begin an attack
units_of_measure.cooldown_jitter_min: loops, lower bound of random U(min, max) added to weapon cooldown
units_of_measure.cooldown_jitter_max: loops, upper bound of random weapon cooldown jitter
units_of_measure.projectile_delay: loops from projectile arrival to damage application
units_of_measure.projectile_offset: tiles, launch offset from attacker center
units_of_measure.attack_spacing: loops between consecutive hits of a multi-attack weapon
units_of_measure.hit_slow_factor: movement speed multiplier applied on hit
units_of_measure.hit_slow_loops: loops duration of on-hit slow (refreshed on re-hit)
units_of_measure.shield_regen_delay: loops after last damage before shield regeneration starts
units_of_measure.projectile_*_air: air-weapon projectile parameters (same semantics as unsuffixed ground keys)
units_of_measure.projectile_to_center: 1 if ground projectile travels to target center instead of edge (not inherited by air)
units_of_measure.projectile_instant_edge: tiles edge-to-edge threshold for same-loop instant hit on ground weapon (not inherited by air)
units_of_measure.turret_rate: rad/loop, turret turn rate before firing (replaces facing_rate)
units_of_measure.min_range: tiles edge-to-edge minimum weapon range; unit holds order without firing or moving inside it
units_of_measure.splash_radial_radius_k / splash_radial_f: radial splash ring k damage fraction when center-to-victim-edge <= radius
units_of_measure.splash_perp_half_length / splash_perp_ha: tiles, unattenuated splash segment through primary target perpendicular to attack direction
units_of_measure.splash_forward_length / splash_forward_h: tiles, unattenuated splash segment extending forward from attacker edge along attack direction
units_of_measure.splash_friendly: 1 if splash damages allied units, 0 otherwise
units_of_measure.suicide_*: suicide attack: detonates at edge <= trigger_range dealing damage + light bonus, or unarmored damage_structure to structures
units_of_measure.barrier_absorb / barrier_duration / barr: Immortal Barrier: triggered on damage (initial hit applies normally); absorb amount, duration in loops (inclusive of trigger loop + duration), and cooldown in loops.
units_of_measure.charge_*: Zealot Charge (map-gated via map_abilities.json): charge_speed tiles/loop; triggers within charge_range_small/large by target radius, lasts up to charge_max_loops with charge_cooldown, adds unarmored charge_bonus on first strike against stationary target
units_of_measure.range_radius: tiles, effective combat/acquisition radius when config.range_radius="measured" (measured along x-axis for structures: Spore Crawler 0.63, Command Center 2.51, Bunker 1.51)
units_of_measure.follow_lock: loops; post-fire hold duration L before chasing out-of-range targets (active when config.follow_lock=True). During the L loops after firing, the unit does not chase; on loop L it chases if strictly out of range, otherwise only when exceeding range + follow_slop (1.0).

note: Omitted keys indicate instantaneous behavior or non-applicable mechanics (e.g., ground units have no acceleration lag; omitted projectile keys mean instant hit; omitted regen keys mean no regen). Among *_RL variants, only Medivac_RL differs in turning kinematics (interpolated via rl_turn='curve'). Colossus, Immortal, and SiegeTankSieged keep fixed observed facing. Queen ground projectiles apply instantaneously when edge-to-edge distance <= 3.0. Immortal Barrier cooldown is ~717 loops (32 game seconds).
